title: Day-of-Intake Signature Packet Checklist
disclaimer: Operational checklist only — not legal advice. Counsel must approve forms for your jurisdiction before use.

sections.title: Before client signs
items: Confirm Medicare vs non-Medicare branch (wrong pack breaks subrogation later)
Confirm minor → use minor HIPAA + counsel-approved minor fee agreement
Staff ready to copy ID, insurance cards, any bills client brought

sections.title: Questionnaire (client fills — not signed as packet)

items.label: HIPAA — leave facility name BLANK at signing
Consent for disclosure
items.template: 3.- CONSENT FOR DISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION WA.docx

items.label: Standard intake docs bundle
items.template: (WA) Intake Docs - Not a Medicare Recipient.docx

sections.title: After signing
items: Case manager reviews questionnaire legibility before data entry
Scan entire signed packet → matter Documents → classify as Intake
Hand client Needs List with appointment dates written on it
Open 3P claim day one — generate 3P LOR from template library
Enter DOL, SOL, contact info on matter record

sections.title: Collect from client (Needs List — not part of signature packet)
items: Auto insurance dec page (1P and 3P if known)
Any hospital / ER / ambulance bills in hand
